answer: Treat trust as water flowing through a grove of agents: each verified agent may pass only a fixed trickle of reputation along its links, and rewards go to whoever receives flow from a random walk seeded at long-standing honest nodes. A sybil swarm can mint a dune of fake identities, but they all hang off a few attack edges, so the flow reaching them stays capped no matter how many clones exist. Writing a sonnet of new accounts buys nothing; only real, slowly earned connections widen the channel.
